inclusion_criteria.title: Publication Type
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must be peer-reviewed and published in a conference proceeding or journal.

inclusion_criteria.title: Language
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must be written entirely in English.

inclusion_criteria.title: From 2018
inclusion_criteria.desc: The study must be from 2018 to 2026.

exclusion_criteria.title: Acronym Ambiguity / Distinct Domain
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study uses the acronym "BPM" to refer to areas completely unrelated to the scope (such as Beats Per Minute in medicine or music, Bits Per Month in telecommunications, or generic project management lacking a process-oriented discipline).

exclusion_criteria.title: Incompatible Technological Focus
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study addresses BPM or software solely from a strictly technical perspective—such as programming, network infrastructure, or information security—without any connection to business processes, modeling, or organizational management.

exclusion_criteria.title: Exclusive Focus on Large Corporations
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study analyzes the implementation of BPM or AI in large multinational companies, mature corporations, or the public sector, where the realities faced by micro and small enterprises—such as resource scarcity, informality, and infrastructure constraints—do not apply.

exclusion_criteria.title: Duplication
exclusion_criteria.desc: The study is a duplicate or an older, less complete version of a study already included by the authors.

exclusion_criteria.title: Missing Abstract
exclusion_criteria.desc: The publication lacks an abstract or metadata summary for preliminary title/abstract screening.
